data.action: 浴衣并肩牵手走过摊位，烟花亮起时侧头微笑
data.camera: medium two-shot, festival crowd, hand holding, firework glow
data.description: 【夏祭街道·夜】紫藤花纹的浴衣衬着忍的笑靥，苹果糖的甜香混在祭典的喧嚣里。人潮涌动的路口，她自然而然地把手递给你——「人潮里牵着就不会走散了。……嗯？脸红什么，只是防走失措施而已哦？……啊，烟花开始了。不快点看的话，就要错过了。」
data.lighting: 灯笼暖光与远处烟花的冷艳
data.promptProse: At the festival crossing, Shinobu Kocho extends her hand to her companion so they can stay together through the crowd. Her lavender wisteria yukata, pale-purple obi and butterfly-pinned bun remain clear as she turns toward the starting fireworks. The medium two-shot keeps people passing farther behind the pair. Warm lantern light reveals their clasped fingers and sleeve pattern, while cool firework flashes momentarily separate the bun from the night sky.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 夏祭夜路的并肩·「人潮里，牵着就不会走散了」
